contentText: Trump touted the U.S. ​military actions in Iran on Thursday, saying they were ‌destroying Tehran's missile and drone capability and that "their navy is gone - 24 ships in three days," as ‌he called on Iranian diplomats to request asylum and help shape ​a better country. "We also urge Iranian diplomats around the world to request asylum and to help us shape a ​new and better Iran," he said. FRANCE 24's Fraser Jackson reports from Washington.
